- Suicidal/Self-Harm/Risk to Others: Denied/not assessed; no indications.

Formulation:
Predisposing: None identified.
Precipitating: 1-week physical illness (sore throat, cough) leading to worry.
Perpetuating: Internet searching of serious conditions may maintain anxiety.
Protective: Good functioning; sought professional consultation; no mental health history.

Mental Health Care Plan Details

Principal Problem: No formal mental health disorder identified
- Patient Goal(s): Reassurance that symptoms are not serious.
- Clinical Goal(s): Monitor for emerging anxiety; provide support if health worry persists.
- Actions (Patient): Follow physical health advice; limit unhelpful internet searching; seek review if anxiety or physical symptoms worsen.
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Provide clear information and safety-netting; reassess mental health if patient re-presents.

Secondary Problem: Situational health-related worry
- Patient Goal(s): Reduce worry; return to normal activity.
- Clinical Goal(s): Support coping strategies; watch for escalation into clinically significant anxiety disorder.
- Actions (Patient): Use suggested coping techniques (e.g., structured information sources, relaxation).
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Offer psychoeducation on normal illness trajectory; consider brief CBT referral if worry persists >4 weeks.

Patient Education, Emergency Care & Relapse Prevention:
- Education Given: Yes. Topics Covered: Expected course of viral illness, red-flag symptoms, when to seek further care, reassurance.
- Early Warning Signs of Relapse/Worsening: Increasing persistent worry, sleep disturbance, avoidance of activities, continued Google searching causing distress.
- Coping Strategies: Limit online searches to reputable sources; engage in normal routine as tolerated; relaxation techniques.

Consent, Coordination & Review:
- Patient Consent to Plan: Not recorded.
- Copy of Mental Health Care Plan Given to Patient: Not recorded.
- Other Mental Health Professionals Involved in Patient Care: None currently.
- GP Acknowledgment (if completed by other MH Professional): Not recorded.
- Review Date: Not recorded (suggest within 4-6 weeks if concerns persist).
